title: Hierarchy-Aware Supervised Uncertainty Estimation for Black-box LLM Taxonomic Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.22839v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for scientific decision support, yet reliable confidence estimation remains difficult in black-box settings. We study uncertainty estimation for hierarchical taxonomic reasoning generated by a black-box LLM in a long-tailed biodiversity monitoring pipeline. Using proxy features extracted by an open-source tool LLM, we train lightweight supervised estimators with hierarchy-aware supervision to predict rank-wise correctness. Across three tool LLMs, the supervised estimators consistently outperform a token-likelihood baseline for micro discrimination and selective prediction under a single global rejection threshold, improving micro AUROC from 0.57 to 0.75--0.80. The best results are achieved by a rank-specific multi-head design (H3), suggesting that accounting for hierarchical output structure is important when a unified abstention rule is required. Our code is publicly available at http

translated_title: 层级感知的监督不确定性估计用于黑盒大语言模型分类学推理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于科学决策支持，但在黑盒设置中，可靠的置信度估计仍然困难。我们研究了在长尾生物多样性监测流程中，由黑盒LLM生成的层级分类学推理的不确定性估计。利用开源工具LLM提取的代理特征，我们训练了轻量级监督估计器，并采用层级感知的监督来预测每个分类等级的准确性。在三个工具LLM上，监督估计器在微判别和单一全局拒绝阈值下的选择性预测方面，始终优于基于令牌似然的基线，将微AUROC从0.57提高到0.75--0.80。最佳结果由等级特定的多头设计（H3）实现，这表明在需要统一弃权规则时，考虑层级输出结构至关重要。我们的代码公开于http。
tldr: 本文提出了一种层级感知的监督不确定性估计方法，通过利用代理特征训练轻量级估计器，显著提升了黑盒LLM在层级分类学推理中的置信度估计性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hierarchy-aware supervised uncertainty estimation method that trains lightweight estimators using proxy features, significantly improving confidence estimation performance for black-box LLM taxonomic reasoning.
